summary:
Held 1 of today's 10 biggest US movers.

• 5 upside misses — FIX +3%, SYK +2%, CHRW +2%, ILMN +2%, RDDT +2%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (CRM -9%, INTU -7%, NOW -7%, NKE -7%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: CRM (-9.20%) — No CRM-specific news. Software sold off on AI-agent disruption fears ahead of Anthropic's IPO; NOW, WDAY and TEAM fell 6-7%. Reports date the ~9.4% drop to Nov 17, so the day label may be off by one. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: CRM is a large-cap software name, and no strategy includes it. The drop was a sector-wide, sentiment-driven gap with no earnings or other discrete catalyst for a news-reactive filter to key on.

top_movers.catalyst: No obvious news catalyst found for 2026-11-18. Comfort Systems (FIX) rose 2.91%, likely on a sector move in data-center/electrical contractors. The only recent item was a Nov 5 buyback expansion.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: FIX is a mid/large-cap HVAC/mechanical contractor, not in the large-cap index or megacap-tech lists. A +2.9% drift with no news also wouldn't trip gap-up or news-reactive triggers.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a daily 'unlisted mover' scan to the momentum-trader universe builder, admitting names with market cap above $10B, 20-day average dollar volume above a floor, and a 60-day relative-strength rank in the top decile, even if outside the index lists.
